Shield-equipped Defiance swap, calculated directly from the verified weapon stats. Relative to Butcher's Cleaver, Cruel Barb changes AP by +12, DPS by -0.64, Agility by -2 and Strength by -5. Buzz Saw changes Agility by +1, Strength by -5, Stamina by +3 and DPS by -0.96. Multiply each by the recorded reference weight. Removing Defiance reduces the AP and weapon-DPS terms relative to the three-rank reference.

restoration_reference_correction.reason: The preliminary healing reference included deep-Feral Natural Instinct. Replace it with the published 11/0/40 Horde healing build. This prevents removing a nonexistent reference conversion from Intellect. Preserve the raw -0.03 MP5 benchmark in source evidence, but use zero for this non-mana-limited case, consistent with the source prose.

scope: 28 Forever profiles. Published priorities are supporting evidence; numerical weights and real item swaps determine approval.

gearmatic.hit_normalization: The piecewise hit curve has unit initial slope under the recorded passive reference talents. Fury off-hand hit is already past the specials cap, so its remaining white-attack contribution is normalized before applying the published marginal coefficient.
gearmatic.limitations: The published scale artifact records simulator provenance and coefficients but does not embed a complete per-profile loadout and encounter configuration. The addon records representative talents and a first-tier boss reference rather than claiming to reproduce that simulation. SixtySim provides the separate documented loadout and one-minute comparison.
gearmatic.units: Damage and healing scales use anchor 6. Mixed tank formula tables retain their published coefficients and are calibrated by weapon-DPS threat ratios. Rating coefficients are per point. Convert hit, crit, haste and expertise to percentage units with the Forever gametable.

sixtysim.limitations: Older build, common simulator ancestry, reference loadouts and rotations. Tank tables emphasize threat. Short healing fights underprice long-fight mana.
sixtysim.sim_commit_scope: Current methodology page; individual comparison pages retain the engines and dates in comparison_sources.
